prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1139; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me, in your own words, what happened on the day of the accident?

A: I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Pearland. I checked my mirror, saw the lane was clear, and started moving over. Then a vehicle in the next lane came up alongside me and its side scraped mine. I didn't see it coming because it was in my blind spot.

Q: Did you have your turn signal on before you moved over?

A: Yes, I had it on for a few seconds before I started moving.

Q: Were there any other vehicles nearby that you noticed?

A: Not that I recall. Traffic was moderate, and I didn't see anything unusual.

Q: Did you stop after the contact, or did you continue driving?

A: I pulled onto the shoulder right away. The other driver also stopped, and we exchanged insurance information.

Q: Did you feel any injuries at the scene?

A: My right knee hurt immediately. I hit it on the door frame when the impact jolted the car. It got stiffer and more painful over the next few hours.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment for the knee?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon and was referred for imaging and physical therapy. I'm still going to appointments.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want the record to show I was driving carefully and following the rules of the road.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
